Author: Solona
Name: Proteus
Description:
• Lets you use overlays — skin-tight gear, tattoos, scales and the like — as a regular Penumbra mod you can toggle on and off, recolour, bind to Glamourer designs and collections, and more.

• Overlays render two ways. Painted into your skin, except now your overlays are dyeable. Or as a second skin, which lets you use sphere maps, metalness and animated glow that skin materials can't do.

• Reshape any mod's models. Paint on your character to pull clothing clear of your body, push it in, smooth it, stretch it across a hollow, or paint where the wind sways it. Hair works too. Edits save into the mod and can be undone.

• Add on/off switches to any part of any mod.

• Make modded hair fit under hats, and undo it any time.

• Import regular old mods and equip them without using a gear slot.

• Save a mod's look as a preset you can wear, share and swap.

• Imports Penumbra .pmp, Onion .omp and Atramentum Luminis .ttmp2 glow tattoos, with no shader mod needed.

• Cloth overlays can enable skindenting with one click.

Type /proteus to manage your Proteus mods.
Punchline: Overlays, off-slot gear and model editing for Penumbra mods
Changelog:
Body size: refit an outfit to another size or another body

The Studio has a new Body size tool. Pick a garment and the body it was
made for (Proteus reads it off the garment for you), choose the sizes or
the body you actually wear, and it refits the outfit to them:

- Between sizes of one body mod, like Neolithe XS to L.
- From one body mod to another that shares its texture layout, like
  Neolithe to Rue+ or Yet Another Body+, with the rig moved to the new
  body's bones.
- Men's bodies as well as women's. It never refits across the two.
- The game's own gear, not only modded outfits.

The refit keeps the cloth on the side of the skin the author put it on,
pushes it back out where the new body comes through, swaps the garment's
skin for the new body's, and leaves hard pieces - buckles, chains, heels -
their own shape. Keep shape on a part marks it as one of those. Save the
refit into the mod's own size list, or into a mod of its own, and it is
switched on for you. Refits open in TexTools and Blender like any other
model.

Also new:
- Move, turn and scale single polygons in the Studio, softly along the
  surface.
- A distance limit slider for the brushes.
- A short what's-new window after an update, and tips the first time you
  use Body size.
- Hat compat is on by default, only fits hair while a hat is worn, and
  keeps a Miqo'te's ear fur.
- /proteus refresh recomposites from chat.
- Import a mod that is already installed in Penumbra, and give imported
  mods Parts tab switches.
- A Copy Logs button in Settings, with your Windows user name taken out.
- A restyled window, and a mod's picture when you hover over it.

Fixes:
- Proteus no longer loses track of its invisible glasses and leaves them on
  you.
- A face is no longer rejected for the body under it.
- The material variant the author dressed is published, not the last one.
- A pack's uncompressed textures are compressed too, and index textures
  when that loses nothing.

Please say if anything looks wrong.

Author: Solona
Name: Camera Tools
Description:
• Presents FFXIV's camera to ReShade as an IGCS camera tool, which is what accumulation depth-of-field add-ons need in order to work. Nothing has ever provided one for FFXIV before.

• Works with iMMERSE Parallax DoF and Otis_Inf's IGCS Depth of Field, and with their panorama and multishot capture.

• Frame the shot however you already do — Group Pose, Cammy, Brio. The camera is only taken over while an add-on is stacking frames, and handed straight back afterwards, so this does not compete with anything else you use.

• Requires ReShade 6.4+ with add-on support, plus a compatible depth-of-field add-on.

Type /camtools to see whether an add-on is connected.
Punchline: Lets ReShade's accumulation depth-of-field add-ons drive the GPose camera.
